verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada collects and handles user and corporate data, so a policy on using that data for AI training is a fair privacy question for this kind of service. The evidence pack covers only incorporation steps, fees, filing channels, annual returns and notifications. It never mentions AI training, data-use opt-outs or a privacy policy on model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
